motion.name: ease-out-expo

motion.name: foil-rule-draw

motion.name: cover-in

motion.name: foil-sheen
motion.value: one pass, 1600ms ease-out-expo, 900ms delay, screen-blended warm highlight skewed -18deg

motion.name: state-color
motion.purpose: Hover and press on buttons and links.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: all animations removed, rules shown drawn, transitions 1ms

narrative.northStar: The Annual Report in Cloth and Foil
narrative.overview:
The site reads as a bound company report: a cover, a contents page with leader rules, then numbered-in-spirit chapters separated by hairlines. The ground is near-black bookcloth in three quiet tonal steps; everything structural is a 1px rule, either dark bronze or gold foil. Nothing floats, glows or lifts. Information is set as schedules, definition lists and ruled lists, the way a prospectus sets particulars, rather than in cards.

Density is deliberately low and type is deliberately large. The root is 18px (112.5%) and with no reader-facing size control, because older partners and officials are a core audience. Libre Caslon Display carries chapter titles and anything ceremonial; Atkinson Hyperlegible Next carries everything that is read. Motion is a single idea, foil stamping: gold rules draw in once, one sheen crosses the emblem on load, nothing loops, and reduced motion renders it all static.

The system rejects the dark-SaaS template: glowing cards, blurred decorative orbs, badges and hero stat counters.
keyCharacteristics: Black bookcloth ground (three steps) with warm off-white ink in three steps.
Gold foil as the single accent, always carried by thin rules, the emblem, numerals, small headings and the primary action.
Hairline structure: 1px rules replace containers; double foil frames mark the two most important panels.
Square corners; 2px radius is the ceiling.
18px root, 20px body in most running text, 48px+ tap targets; browser zoom is the only text scaling.
One motion grammar: draw-in and one-time sheen on the expo-out curve.

rules.name: The Foil Is Metal Rule
rules.body: Foil appears as line, emblem, numeral, small heading or the primary fill; it is never a large background field, gradient or glow. Its tint (10%) appears only as the secondary button's hover wash.

rules.name: The Three Inks Rule
rules.body: Text uses ink, ink-2 or ink-3 only. Nothing dimmer than ink-3 carries words.

rules.name: The Caslon Never Bolds Rule
rules.body: Libre Caslon Display is used at 400 only, never below 1.35rem, and never for anything read in paragraphs. Emphasis in Caslon comes from size and foil, not weight.

rules.name: The Readable Floor Rule
rules.body: Nothing read is set below 1rem (18px at default size); the only smaller text is the 0.875rem uppercase label and the 0.66-0.7rem "Investment Limited" wordmark line.

rules.name: The Stamped, Not Lifted Rule
rules.body: Emphasis is a frame or a rule, never a shadow, glow or lift. If an element needs to stand forward, give it cloth-2 and a double foil frame.

rules.name: The Two-Pixel Ceiling Rule
rules.body: No radius above 2px. No pills, no circles, no rounded cards.

dos: **Do** set structure with 1px rules: bronze (rule, rule-soft) for dividers, foil for openers and the top edge of a key block.
**Do** use the double foil frame on cloth-2 for at most one or two panels per page that carry the main navigation or the main action.
**Do** keep Caslon at weight 400 for titles, quotes, numerals and the wordmark; keep all reading text in Atkinson Hyperlegible Next at 1.125rem or larger.
**Do** keep every tap target at least 2.75rem (48px at default size) and primary actions at 3.5rem.
**Do** present facts as definition lists, ruled lists and schedules with an ink-3 term and ink value.
**Do** make any new motion a one-time draw or reveal on the expo-out curve, and remove it under reduced motion.
donts: **Don't** use cards, box shadows, glows, blurred decorative orbs, gradients or badges; depth is tone and line only.
**Don't** introduce a second accent hue; foil and its bright and deep steps are the only colour.
**Don't** set text in rule or rule-soft, or any text dimmer than ink-3.
**Don't** show hero statistics, counters or invented numbers.
